tools.name: payment_check
tools.description: Payment check: is this seller safe to pay, checked at the moment the agent pays. tools.name: trust_score
tools.description: Seller trust score: check whether a paying agent looks abusive or risky before you accept payment. Scores velocity, failed or refused payments, dispute-like patterns, and new versus established history across the Screwtape.ai seller network. Returns a 0–1 trust score, allow/review/block, risk and re

tools.name: payment_guard_authorize
tools.description: Payment Guard: enforce your own spend rules before an agent pays. Set rules once per API key (or an account default): max_per_call_usd, daily_budget_usd, period_budget_usd + period_hours, allowed_sellers, allowed_domains, max_calls_per_minute, max_calls_per_hour. Then send each payment intent to POS

tools.name: budget_ledger
tools.description: Budget Ledger: atomically reserves reported USD spend across a run and its sub-agents. Returns allow/warn/block, remaining budget, retry storms and spend velocity. Call judge first, then reserve immediately before spending; honor block. This is cooperative accounting, not payment enforcement. Root c

tools.name: action_receipt
tools.description: Action Receipts: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained attestation of an agent-reported action and status; not evidence the action happened or a legal compliance certification. Per caller and agent chain; concurrent appends serialize with compare-and-set. Raw action/reference are hashed, not stored. event_id

tools.name: judge
tools.description: A pass/fail/retry verdict on ONE agent output, from a service outside your agent, used as the go/no-go before an agent spends money or acts on that output. Call it before you pay on, return, store or act on a draft answer, especially when you have the evidence the answer should be based on. Do NOT c

tools.name: check_duplicate_invoice
tools.description: Spend gate for invoices: decides whether an agent may pay this invoice, with a signed receipt as proof. Same as judge with one duplicate check: it compares this invoice with the invoices this caller recorded earlier and also judges it. Call it before an agent pays or approves an invoice or payment i

tools.name: consensus
tools.description: False-consensus check for 2 to 16 answers to the same task, so a group of agents does not approve a spend just because they copied each other. It scores how the answers agree and flags agreement that looks copied or too thin to trust. Screwtape is not tied to the agent framework or the model that wr

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Create a free Screwtape.ai API key (10 calls per UTC day) with no human approval. Call it only when no Screwtape key is configured and you can compute SHA-256 with a code tool, because the proof of work must be computed exactly, not guessed. Do NOT call it when a key already exists, to get more quot

tools.name: publish_receipt
tools.description: Publish a signed receipt you own so a public page and a Screwtape Verified badge can link to that one verdict. Call it when you want to show that a specific output received a specific verdict. Do NOT call it to certify an agent in general: the page says this output received this verdict at this time

tools.name: try_check
tools.description: See what a spend check returns before you have a key. Runs ONE sample check on a fixed demo invoice: a duplicate match against an invoice paid earlier, required fields, and a sum check that the line items add up to the total. Call it once to learn the response shape. Do NOT call it on your own invoi

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: payment_check, trust_score, payment_guard_authorize, get_api_key · Private data: payment_guard_authorize, budget_ledger, action_receipt, check_duplicate_invoice, get_api_key, publish_receipt · Public sink: payment_guard_authorize, budget_ledger, action_receipt, get_api_key, publish_receipt · Destructive: budget_ledger, action_receipt, judge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: payment_check, trust_score, payment_guard_authorize, get_api_key · Private data: payment_guard_authorize, budget_ledger, action_receipt, check_duplicate_invoice, get_api_key, publish_receipt · Public sink: payment_guard_authorize, budget_ledger, action_receipt, get_api_key, publish_receipt · Destructive: budget_ledger, action_receipt, judge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
